steps.note: S2.1.4 states the net target change (JV+RG)x for any initial scratch vectors, with rows 0-1 subtracting Ja+Rc and rows 4-5 adding back J(a+Vx)+R(c+Gx), and S2.1.3 has the final undo rows restoring scratch, as in the paper.
S2.1.5 gives central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero for intersections zero and two, and self coefficient one, matching the paper.
S2.1.6 gives central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2 with the side cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, as in the paper.
S2.1.7 gives the forward/inverse/forward stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), and S2.1 with S2.1.0 states that each invocation has its own scratch wires, all returned to their initial values.

S2.3.3 asserts nested nondegenerate labels on every edge, and S2.3.3.3 tabulates the residual dimension of every edge, each matching the paper's table; the residual subspaces are given only through the gate labels of S2.3.3.2 and the centre residual P⊗F.

S2.3.3.3 gives the side edge 2->5 dimension h-2 using <t_X>⊂t_Y^⊥ for neighbours (orthogonal by S2.3.1), between the labels of S2.3.3.2; the complement is not named as <t_X,t_Y>^⊥, but its dimension and reason are stated.
The plan states that only the centre edge 3->4 decreases, losing h; the gate-wise telescoping; source sum N, sink sum Wm-N, signed Wm-2N; and the absolute sum Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, as in the paper.

S2.3.3.6 states that over F_2 every nonzero residual is nonalternating via a norm-one coordinate vector outside the earlier supports, hence has an orthonormal basis, supported by the line-1087 quote; the plane-absorption construction itself is not spelled out.
S2.3.4 gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 exactly.
S2.4.1 states that weight is additive mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors, giving q_V-q_U=Σ wt(v)[v·x] over an orthonormal basis of the residual.
S2.4.2-S2.4.3 state that wt(v) is odd, so the phase is i^{ε[v·x]}, and that H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into the kernel aI+bX_v or its inverse, as in the paper.

S2.4 states one kernel per residual basis vector with s_c in all; S2.4.7 extends this to k columns, and S2.9.1.4/S2.9.1.7 apply each residual direction as one tensored factor (C^{ε_h})^{⊗f} over the columns, s_c in all.

S2.4.5-S2.4.7 give the X_a->Y_a phase wt(x)+2[u·x], C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates repaired by Z before and i^{27k}Z after via C=iZC^{-1}Z, and negation of the X outputs; that zero and full labels have frames I and C^{⊗m} is only implicit in the claim that every role carries C^{⊗m}.
The plan states that both loss ratios are below 1/2, that the deficit N-2L_b>0 because L_b<N/2 (2N-2L_c>0 for the complex network), and that s_b<W_b m.
S2.5.2-S2.5.5 state that both deficits exceed 20·2^{-50} and log m<20, so m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-η) and s/W<m^τ with τ=σ=1-2^{-50}.

S2.6.2 gives the elimination (pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower-triangular elementary operations on both sides, scaling, deleting the pivot row and column, repeating), and S2.6.1 gives Π with exactly a ones.

S2.6.3 states that a fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators is chosen once, so the factorisation works over Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors (S2.6); the 'finite table' wording is paraphrased as 'chosen once'.
S2.6.3 states that a lower-triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, each by a unit multiple plus earlier coordinates via controlled shifts.
S2.6.5-S2.6.6 give D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j, yielding (h+d,d) with one interchange per one of Π, a in all.
S2.9.5.3 gives A(e)≤sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)≤8e at a leaf, with the per-invocation gates and corrections below E.
S2.9.5.4-S2.9.5.6 give sx+E≤Bx, B^{k+1}≤B^2 d^ν, hence A(e)≤8B^2 d^{ν+1}, and a total below 128mB^2 d^{ν+3}≤C_0 d^{C_1}.
S2.9.5.7-S2.9.5.8 state that depth ℓ gives values in 2^{-(p+ℓ)}Z[i] of modulus at most 2^ℓ, that p+Δ fractional and Δ+3 integer bits are exact, and that εC_1<1 gives Δ=o(p).
S2.9.6 states that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so outputs stay in the unit disk and the truncation error is below √2·2^{-p}.

summary: P05 is a very detailed plan whose infer steps reproduce the paper's sub-derivations almost line by line, so all 26 checklist sub-steps are present and none is stated contrary to the paper. Minor gaps: the residual subspaces of L1 are given as dimensions rather than named; L2 does not name the complement <t_X,t_Y>^⊥; L4 omits the plane-absorption construction; P4 leaves the I and C^{⊗m} frames of the zero and full labels implicit. Each sub-step's defining mechanism is still stated.
